Look for the classic failures: a quantifier swapped, an induction hypothesis used at the wrong level, a bound that holds only for the sizes checked, an outside theorem used beyond its hypotheses, a circular use of the statement. It prints `HIT: confirmed - <the claim survives; what you verified independently>` or `SUMMARY: fails at step <n> - <why>`; always a SUMMARY line. If your model family is the author's, release the unit.
